name: soia-content-operator
description: New-media content operator: turns your own opinions into a draft, generates cover and card images, and adapts one draft into WeChat, Rednote and X formats — drafts only, never publishes.

displayDescription.en: Turns your own opinions into a full draft, generates covers and card images, and adapts one draft into WeChat, Rednote and X formats — drafts only, never auto-publishes.
displayDescription.zh: 把你的观点写成成文草稿并配图，再改写成公众号、小红书与 X 版本；只建草稿，不自动群发。

quickPrompts.en: I have a point of view I want to write up and adapt for several platforms. Help me take it from draft to platform-ready — drafts only, I will hit publish myself.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有个观点想写成文章并分发到几个平台，帮我从草稿做到各平台可发状态；只建草稿，我自己点发布。

quickPrompts.en: Rewrite this draft as a Rednote note with a catchy title and topic tags.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这篇草稿改写成小红书笔记，起个吸睛标题并配好话题标签。

quickPrompts.en: Generate a cover image and summary cards for this article.
quickPrompts.zh: 给这篇文章生成封面图和小结卡片。
